v0.29.0_f6018e45.title: Plan Mode: A new comprehensive planning capability with /plan, enter_plan_mode tool, and dedicated documentation (#17698 by @Adib234, #18324 by @jerop).

v0.29.0_375933fd.title: Gemini 3 Default: We’ve removed the preview flag and enabled Gemini 3 by default for all users (#18414 by @sehoon38).

v0.29.0_78632065.title: Extension Exploration: New UI and settings to explore and manage extensions more easily (#18686 by @sripasg).

v0.29.0_b149a619.title: Admin Control: Administrators can now allowlist specific MCP server configurations (#18311 by @skeshive).

v0.28.0_369c7155.title: Slash Command: We’ve added a new /prompt-suggest slash command to help you generate prompt suggestions (#17264 by @NTaylorMullen).

v0.28.0_3713dc1f.title: IDE Support: Gemini CLI now supports the Positron IDE (#15047 by @kapsner).

v0.28.0_f8511c05.title: Customization: You can now use custom themes in extensions, and we’ve implemented automatic theme switching based on your terminal’s background (#17327 by @spencer426, #17976 by @Abhijit-2592).

v0.28.0_18121c9a.title: Authentication: We’ve added interactive and non-interactive consent for OAuth, and you can now include your auth method in bug reports (#17699 by @ehedlund, #17569 by @erikus).

v0.27.0_c3be194e.title: Event-Driven Architecture: The CLI now uses a new event-driven scheduler for tool execution, resulting in a more responsive and performant experience (#17078 by @abhipatel12).

v0.27.0_1b409f43.title: Enhanced User Experience: This release includes queued tool confirmations, and expandable large text pastes for a smoother workflow.
